new_sources.title: Prime Minister’s address on coronavirus, 23 March 2020
new_sources.factual_summary: Johnson instructed people to stay at home, explained permitted exceptions and announced that restrictions would be reviewed in three weeks against evidence.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Text establishes the content and clarity of communication, not inner composure, public compliance or whether the timing was appropriate.
new_sources.locator: Stay-at-home instructions, exceptions and three-week review paragraphs

new_sources.title: PM statement on coronavirus, 12 March 2020
new_sources.factual_summary: Johnson warned that more families would lose loved ones, described the scientific advice and set out the measures then being taken.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Compare with 23 March rather than treating a changed response as automatically inconsistent. Claims of scientific guidance remain the speaker’s account.

new_sources.title: Manchester terror attack — statement from Mayor Andy Burnham
new_sources.factual_summary: The reproduced statement acknowledges grief and anger, calls for solidarity, provides emergency contact information and asks people to share trusted information.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Official page displays a later 2018 timestamp. GC_AB03 corroborates the 23 May 2017 occasion; no claim of contemporaneous website publication is made.

new_sources.title: Burnham says he would accept imposed Tier 3 restrictions
new_sources.factual_summary: In the reported interview Burnham said he would accept legally imposed restrictions while explaining concerns about harm to residents.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: A reported interview, not an independently tested account of negotiations or proof that all his communication remained calm.
new_sources.locator: Quotation from interview with Kay Burley

new_sources.title: The President’s remarks on H1N1
new_sources.factual_summary: Obama distinguished concern from panic, described consultation with public-health officials and explained why they did not recommend closing the Mexican border.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Direct communication evidence; medical appropriateness and implementation require other records. Publication is a day after the conference.
new_sources.locator: Press-conference question and answer reproduced in post

new_sources.title: Remarks by the President on Ebola
new_sources.factual_summary: Obama advocated science-based monitoring, distinguished facts from fear and said he would obtain input from returning health workers.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Announced consultation is not proof that it occurred; reassurance does not prove effectiveness or consistent composure across the presidency.
new_sources.locator: Monitoring guidance and health-worker input paragraphs

new_sources.title: Barack Obama incumbent financial disclosure, calendar year 2015
new_sources.factual_summary: The visually inspected cover identifies Obama’s personal incumbent financial disclosure for calendar year 2015 and includes signatures.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Text extraction is empty. Only the cover was inspected visually; no asset inventory, compliance conclusion or absence of conflicts is claimed.

new_sources.title: The President donates Nobel Prize money to charity
new_sources.factual_summary: The White House announced the charities designated to receive the Nobel Prize proceeds.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Announcement alone establishes intention. The subsequent transfer confirmation in GS_BO04 is the stronger action evidence.

new_sources.title: KanzlerGESPRÄCH in Füssen
new_sources.author_or_issuing_institution: Federal Government account of questions and Scholz’s answers
new_sources.factual_summary: The account records citizens’ questions about social insurance, skills, families and refugee employment, with Scholz’s direct responses.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Government-selected account of a managed event, not an independent measure of empathy or proof that answers caused policy changes.

new_sources.title: KanzlerGESPRÄCH in Bendorf
new_sources.author_or_issuing_institution: Federal Government account of questions and Scholz’s answers
new_sources.factual_summary: The account records Scholz answering citizens about pensions and family support, including a commitment concerning basic support for children.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Verifies recorded personal engagement, not delivery of the commitment. Do not turn attendance or a promise into sustained responsiveness.

new_sources.title: Televised address on the Russian attack against Ukraine
new_sources.factual_summary: Scholz acknowledged citizens’ anxiety, described allied coordination and sanctions, and said the conflict should be prevented from spreading to other European countries.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Content of an acute-crisis address, not proof of internal calm, military outcomes or the completeness of preparation.

new_sources.title: Archived member biography and mandatory disclosures, 20th Bundestag
new_sources.factual_summary: The archive lists declared functions and an interest in the law partnership Zimmermann, Scholz und Partner.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Disclosure is not proof of an improper conflict or of its resolution. The archive does not establish the decision-level recusal and benefit history needed for Service.

new_sources.title: Greater Manchester Mayor’s Charity CIO annual report and accounts, year ended 31 March 2024
new_sources.author_or_issuing_institution: Charity trustees; filed with Charity Commission
new_sources.factual_summary: The charity’s accounts identify a £12,375 contribution from patron Andy Burnham in the period and a £15,125 comparative figure for 2023.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Recipient-filed accounts, not personal bank statements or a guarantee of all annual payments. Do not infer a universal salary percentage or equate contributions with overall public-duty quality.
new_sources.locator: Accounts related-party note and fundraising section; PDF pages 11 and 41

new_sources.title: Greater Manchester Mayor’s Charity CIO annual report and accounts, year ended 31 March 2025
new_sources.author_or_issuing_institution: Charity trustees; filed with Charity Commission
new_sources.factual_summary: The annual report identifies £11,050 donated by Burnham and separately describes a £10,000 Sky speaker-fee contribution on his behalf in lieu of some direct payments.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Do not add the Sky fee as another direct personal payment or extrapolate a continuous payment history. The report explains an allocation spanning reporting periods.

new_sources.title: President Obama and Vice President Biden’s tax returns
new_sources.factual_summary: The tax-release explanation states that Obama directed the Nobel Prize funds to charities, with the prize excluded from income and no charitable deduction for its value.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: An official tax explanation, not a new audit or proof of motive. The account should not imply an additional charitable deduction was claimed.

new_sources.title: Nobel donation instructions and Foundation transfer confirmation
new_sources.factual_summary: Obama’s signed instruction directs the award to charities; the Foundation’s signed 12 April confirmation states that the proceeds were transferred on 18 March 2010.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Four-page scan inspected visually; no automated OCR claim. It establishes this documented disposal of an award, not absence of other conflicts or a general judgement about motives.
new_sources.locator: PDF page 1 instruction; page 4 Foundation confirmation; visually inspected

new_sources.title: Manchester wakes up after darkest of nights
new_sources.factual_summary: ITV’s dated coverage records Burnham’s address after the Arena attack and his expression of grief, shock and anger.
new_sources.reliability_and_relevance_notes: Corroborates occasion and words; does not verify emotional state or the quality of emergency-service operations.

followup_decisions.question_answered: Does the packet now contain directly attributable evidence of the missing behaviour?
followup_decisions.new_judgement: The March 2020 addresses provide directly attributable acute-crisis communication: a severe warning followed by explicit stay-at-home instructions, exceptions and an evidence-linked review point. This supports a qualified analysis of clarity, risk framing and explanation of change.
followup_decisions.limitations: The timing and adequacy of decisions, actual delivery and consistency throughout the premiership remain contested or incomplete. Existing pandemic criticism is retained; words do not prove inner composure.

followup_decisions.question_answered: Does the packet now contain directly attributable evidence of the missing behaviour?
followup_decisions.new_judgement: The Arena address provides actual acute-event language combining acknowledgement of shock, public solidarity and practical information. The 2020 interview supplies a second pressured episode in which legal compliance and harms to residents were discussed.
followup_decisions.limitations: The official address page has a later timestamp; ITV corroborates the occasion. Accounts of community gaps and policing failures remain relevant. Neither transcript establishes the quality of all operations or constant calm over nine years.

followup_decisions.question_answered: Does the packet now contain directly attributable evidence of the missing behaviour?
followup_decisions.new_judgement: Recipient-filed accounts now document named personal contributions in successive reporting periods, replacing reliance solely on a salary pledge. The Sky speaker fee is a separate category and is not counted as an additional direct personal donation.
followup_decisions.limitations: The documents establish specified contributions, not an unbroken percentage of salary, complete conflict management or absence of ambition. A complete interests and recusal history is still not assembled.

followup_decisions.question_answered: Does the packet now contain directly attributable evidence of the missing behaviour?
followup_decisions.new_judgement: The H1N1 and Ebola texts directly address acute public anxiety, explain reliance on public-health advice and distinguish precaution from panic. They support a qualified finding about the content of communication in two different public-health crises.
followup_decisions.limitations: Statements about consultation are not proof of implementation or medical correctness. Other first-term crises and contrary communications require broader sampling; rollout and civilian-harm evidence is preserved.

followup_decisions.question_answered: Does the packet now contain directly attributable evidence of the missing behaviour?
followup_decisions.new_judgement: The signed award-disposal instruction and subsequent Foundation confirmation provide a concrete case of foregoing a personal financial award. The tax explanation prevents attributing a further charitable deduction to the transfer; the disclosure cover establishes only that a report exists.
followup_decisions.limitations: A documented charitable transfer does not establish pure motives, consistent public-duty prioritisation or absence of conflicts. Surveillance concerns, ethics waivers and incomplete recusal evidence remain relevant.

followup_decisions.question_answered: Does the packet now contain directly attributable evidence of the missing behaviour?
followup_decisions.new_judgement: The event accounts now connect named citizen questions to Scholz’s own recorded answers. This is directly attributable engagement, unlike relying on a Foreign Office participation process alone.
followup_decisions.limitations: Both accounts are government-selected, managed-event records from 2023. Empathy, representativeness, follow-through and the effect of listening on decisions throughout the chancellorship are not established.

followup_decisions.question_answered: Does the packet now contain directly attributable evidence of the missing behaviour?
followup_decisions.new_judgement: The address on the invasion day directly acknowledges anxiety and explains allied coordination, sanctions and the aim of containing escalation. It supplies acute-crisis communication evidence missing from an assessment based on coalition accusations alone.
followup_decisions.limitations: The later budget and coalition material remains qualifying context, not proof that all communication was calm. Internal decision quality, counterpart accounts and outcomes remain incompletely researched.

followup_decisions.question_answered: Does the packet now contain directly attributable evidence of the missing behaviour?
followup_decisions.new_judgement: The archived personal disclosures identify functions and a partnership interest, but do not show how competing interests were managed in actual chancellorship decisions. They support a disclosure observation, not a finding that public duty outweighed private advantage.
followup_decisions.limitations: No sufficient decision-level benefit, recusal or foregone-advantage case has been established. Presence of a declared interest is not evidence of misconduct; absence of an identified adverse case is not exoneration.
